g.text: Direction panel on a perpendicular grid (grid north)
Grid squares 1 km (1:50,000); x east, y north in metres.
A→B is due east: 090°. A→D is due north: 000°. A→C has equal
2,000 m east and north offsets, so it bisects the right angle:
Reverse: B→A = 090° + 180° = 270°. B has the same northing as A,
so there is no north–south offset.
A reading of 225° for C would point south-west, the opposite
quadrant, so recheck it. These straight lines do not show a safe
20 cm wide; else use the bar.
Height rises inwards from 1,510 m to the 1,540 m spot height: a
With a common 10 m interval, contours are closer on the east
Contours show relief only: they do not show vegetation or what
